final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count FROM major_counts) SELECT major_counts.link_to_major, major_counts.member_count, major_counts.member_count * 1.0 / total.total_count FROM major_counts JOIN total ON total.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY major_counts.member_count * 1.0 / total.total_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
